full_page.content:
1934, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 169 Cont.
Jan. 16th Mrs. Ag. murphy Mckay - 55 - operated on for cancer on breast 3 yrs. ago, now becoming very anoying ... fears ... Husband not Cath.
Rinke Family - unemployed now near 12 mo. - go to sacrament fre- quent.
Mrs. Rose Forrest - 61 - heart trouble - rheumatism 4 years ago cured. ....
Mrs. LaCroix - 52 - 6 in family trying to make honest living by keeping apartment in order etc.
Page 170 Jan. Mrs. Anna Rose - 8 - cronic appendix - very much suffering. Florence Jablonski - 25 - dizzy - stomach etc.
17th Mrs. Concett Privitera - 38 - sad experience with Mrs. Garth .... attended "Communion services "received" bread & wine from her last Good Fr. Enrolled last Wed. (50c) promising perpetual - if helpt. To-day O.K. Enrolls perpet.
Mrs. Edna Gabrish - 34 - prayed for last Wed. - has 7 little ones - youngest a week old - Drs. wonder at her still living - prayed for last W.
Mrs. Rose Liss - 67 - losing sight ....
Fredie Algers ..
(Cont. from Page 169 - Jan. 16th) Said Maureen Kay's mother had been going to Communion about 3 times a yr. promised weekly Com. Specialist himself seemed surprised next day - i.e. Today Child out of danger. Aug. 7th Girl M. Kay comes to Monastery O.K.
18 Jimmey Thora - 5 - pneumonia last Oct. 16 Mother phoned about 2 p.m. - fever left and boy took dinner - phones To-day Terrible asthma on Jan. 18 was gone next day .... Thank God. Feb. 5th - Same Jimmy Thorn here To-day in perfect health.
Page 171 Jan. 18th Paul Krause - 26 - short of breath - not able to work - wife & baby ... . anxious.
18th A. Goritski - 47 - of Pt. Austin - groth in bladder - terrible pains - Enrolled To-day.
